Hello, I'm Dillon.

I started using Lean rather recently as part of a learning project to do with retrodictive forecasting and ordinal analysis. This 'learning project' has scaled in scope in-line with an onerous home renovation project for which it provides respite. Given my lack of formal training (hence an over-reliance on LLMs), most of the work has gone towards falsification engineering, and I suppose any posts I make under "AI authored projects" are yet another gate to that effect.

I am currently tooling around with a formalization of a data layer for Nat.RecursiveIn after coming across 38973
